name: AJ Networks Co.,Ltd.
summary: AJ Networks Co.,Ltd. delivers a comprehensive array of rental solutions to clients across South Korea and on the international stage. Their core services are divided into three main categories: logistics equipment, IT hardware, and construction machinery. Within their construction equipment portfolio, the company offers specialized items such as aerial work platforms and a variety of building materials. For logistics, their offerings include various types of pallets, forklifts, and other essential supply chain apparatus. The IT equipment division is particularly extensive, featuring a wide selection of computing hardware like desktops, laptops, and workstations, complemented by peripherals such such as monitors, digital complexers, printers, commercial shredders, and scanners. They also provide various display and presentation technologies, including televisions, digital signage, interactive electronic boards, and beam projectors, alongside mobile devices like smartphones and tablets. Expanding beyond conventional IT, AJ Networks also rents out household appliances such as air purifiers, air conditioners, water filtration systems, and massage chairs. Additionally, they offer specialized technical services, including web conferencing systems, PC recovery tools, kiosks, robotic units, and server rentals. Founded in 2000, AJ Networks Co.,Ltd. maintains its corporate headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
